# find_missing_hash_sidecars

[← Command index](README.md)

List files on a remote locker that have no entry in its hash sidecar database.

## Synopsis

```
find_missing_hash_sidecars [options]
```

## Description

Lists every file on the remote locker (or under `--path`) with rclone, reads the
`.locker_hashes.db` sidecar from the locker root, and reports each remote file whose
path relative to the locker root has no entry in it. The sidecar database itself is
left out of the listing.

This matters for remotes that cannot hash files themselves, such as the SFTP-based
Hetzner locker: `locker_sync_tool` and `master_backup` compare against the sidecar,
so a file missing from it is treated as absent from the remote.

The first 20 missing paths are logged along with the total; `--report` writes the
complete list to a file. The tool only reads; fix gaps with `rebuild_hash_sidecars`.

## Options

### General

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `-l, --locker_type <locker_type>` | Remote locker to check. Default: `Hetzner`. Allowed: `All`, `Local`, `Hetzner`, `Gdrive`, `External`. |
| `--path <path>` | Subtree relative to the locker root to list, e.g. `Gaming/Roms`; the whole locker when empty. |
| `-r, --report <report>` | File to write the complete list of missing paths to; when omitted only the first 20 are logged. |

### Common options

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `-v, --verbose` | Enable verbose mode. |
| `-p, --pretend_run` | Do a pretend run with no permanent changes. |
| `-x, --exit_on_failure` | Enable exit on failure mode. |
| `--no-preview` | Skip the preview confirmation prompt. |

## Examples

### Check the whole Hetzner locker

```bash
find_missing_hash_sidecars
```

### Check one subtree

```bash
find_missing_hash_sidecars --path "Gaming/Roms" -v
```

### Write the full list of missing files to a report

```bash
find_missing_hash_sidecars -r /tmp/missing_sidecars.txt
```

### Check the Gdrive locker's sidecar

```bash
find_missing_hash_sidecars -l Gdrive
```

## Notes

- The sidecar is always read from the locker root, even when `--path` limits the listing to a subtree; listed paths are prefixed with `--path` before they are looked up.
- The locker must be a configured rclone remote; the tool stops otherwise.
